incidents.name: xWin Finance Subscribe price-impact validation bypass
incidents.notes: xWinDefi.Subscribe() accepted an attacker-supplied priceImpactTolerance of 100% and paid a subscription/referral xWIN reward on every call, so a flash-loaned subscribe-redeem loop farmed xWIN rewards without any effective slippage check.
